newsitem.title: UK: UK watchdog welcomes moves by pensions providers.
newsitem.headline: UK watchdog welcomes moves by pensions providers.

text.p: The UK's top financial watchdog, the Securities and Investments Board (SIB) said on Wednesday it welcomed moves by personal pension providers to mitigate the effect of flat-rate charges on small personal pension funds.

"We welcome the action so far taken by personal pension providers. It shows they are taking seriously the risk that annual flat-rate charges may cause loss for vulnerable individuals," SIB chief executive Andrew Winckler said.
The SIB's comments followed the publication of a survey on the charges levied on personal pensions funded by rebates from the State Earnings Related Pension Scheme (SERPS).
